title: Aftergraph Capability Contract
description: Canonical Trust Gateway agent-role capability vocabulary. Owner: Aftergraph/trust-gateway (src/gateway/policy.js ROLE_CAPABILITIES); this file is the governed mirror — edits land in TG, then the mirror is re-copied. AIE lease scopes (resource_prefixes) are a separate axis and out of scope.

role_capabilities.description: Role → granted capability list, mirrored from TG policy.js at contract creation. Unknown roles fall back to ['fs.read', 'web.get']. The implementing-repo conformance test pins code == this map.

prefix.description: Capability ending ':*' grants every tool with that prefix (e.g. 'fs.write:*' grants 'fs.write:logs').

exact.description: Otherwise the capability must equal the tool name.

validation_rules.description: Issuance-time rules. Unknown or invented capabilities are rejected, never default-granted.
default: unknown capabilities are rejected at issuance (invalid_capability)
invented privileged capabilities (e.g. meta-caps like approval.decide outside role) are rejected
absent capabilities resolve to role defaults, never to union or wildcard
